## Problem

## Contains Duplicate

Coding — Software Engineer

Given an integer array `nums`, determine whether at least one value occurs multiple times. Return `true` when any value is present more than once; if every value appears only once, return `false`.

### Examples

Example 1:

Input: `nums = [1, 2, 3, 3]`

Output: `true`

The value `3` occurs twice, so the result is `true`.

Result: true.","panels":[{"type":"array","id":"nums","label":"Input Array","values":["1","2","3","3"],"marks":{"found":[2,3]}}]}],"expected":"true"}


Example 2:

Input: `nums = [1, 2, 3, 4]`

Output: `false`

Every value occurs once, so the result is `false`.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

The core question is whether any element appears more than once—this is a classic membership test problem.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Use a hash set to track seen numbers as you iterate, if you encounter a number already in the set, return true immediately.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

The time complexity is O(n) and space complexity is O(n) in the worst case, no special edge cases beyond an empty array (return false).

</details>
